documents.title: Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Analyst / Investor Meet - Outcome

analysis.summary: Management stated that Q2 FY27 recorded pre-sales of INR470 crores, bringing H1 FY27 pre-sales to INR879 crores, driven by robust demand in Mumbai's luxury housing market. Total revenue for H1 FY27 reached INR401 crores with an EBITDA of INR155 crores and PAT of INR134 crores, supported by a net cash position of INR494 crores. The company added three new projects during the quarter, expanding its ongoing and upcoming pipeline to 24 projects with an aggregate GDV of approximately INR20,000 crores. Management remains confident in achieving its FY27 guidance of INR1,800 crores to INR2,000 crores in pre-sales, along with revenue and PAT growth of 55% to 60%. Sri Lotus Developers and Realty Limited reported robust financial and operational performance for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026, driven by strong pre-sales and revenue growth.

guidance.claim: The company remains confident of delivering its FY27 guideline of pre-sales ranging from INR1,800 crores to INR2,000 crores.
guidance.quote: Together with the momentum from our recent launches and a growing pipeline, we remain confident of delivering our FY27 guideline of pre-sales in the range of INR1,800 crores to INR2,000 crores, along with revenue and PAT growth of 55% to 60% over FY26 levels.

guidance.claim: Management expects EBITDA and PAT margins to be 35% to 40% and 25% to 30% respectively.
guidance.quote: We also remain confident of sustaining strong profitability, with EBITDA and PAT margin expected at 35% to 40% and 25% to 30%, respectively.

guidance.claim: The company remains confident of delivering its stated guidance for FY27 of pre-sales of INR 1,800-2,000 Crs, and revenue and PAT growth of 55-60% over FY26 levels.
guidance.quote: We remain confident of delivering our stated guidance for FY27 of a pre-sales of INR 1,800-2,000 Crs, and revenue and PAT growth of 55-60% over FY26 levels.

guidance.claim: Management remains committed to its FY27 pre-sales guidance ranging between INR1,800 to 2,000 crores.
guidance.quote: Backed by this launch pipeline, strong demand outlook, and the quality of our developments, we remain committed to our FY27 guidance of pre-sales in the range of INR1,800 to 2,000 crores, along with revenue and PAT growth of 55% to 60%.

guidance.claim: EBITDA and PAT margins for FY27 are expected to be at 35% to 40% and 25% to 30%, respectively.
guidance.quote: We remain confident of sustaining strong profitability with EBITDA and PAT margins expected at 35% to 40% and 25% to 30%, respectively.

demand_outlook.claim: Mumbai remains India's largest housing market with sales in the first nine months of calendar 2026 at their highest since 2018.
demand_outlook.quote: Mumbai remains India’s largest housing market, with sales in the first nine months of calendar 2026 at their highest since 2018, and the luxury segment continues to lead.

demand_outlook.claim: Demand is largely driven by end users upgrading to larger homes in better locations.
demand_outlook.quote: Demand is driven largely by end users upgrading to larger homes in better locations, while scarce land in prime micromarkets makes redevelopment the principal route to new supply, precisely where Lotus has built its capability.

demand_outlook.claim: Luxury segment buyers rely far less on home loans and buy for long-term value and lifestyle.
demand_outlook.quote: Our buyers rely far less on home loans and buy for long-term value and lifestyle.

demand_outlook.claim: Management highlighted strong demand from financial institutions, fintech firms, and allied sectors for Grade-A commercial spaces, alongside high enquiry levels for luxury residential units at the GIFT City project.
demand_outlook.quote: Strong demand from financial institutions, fintech firms, and allied sectors for Grade-A commercial spaces, coupled with differentiated project positioning and strong brand name translating into high enquiry levels for luxury residential units.

demand_outlook.claim: Pre-sales rose 83% YoY to INR 470 Crs in Q2 FY27, reflecting sustained demand for the company's premium offerings.
demand_outlook.quote: Pre-sales for Q2 FY27 grew 83% YoY to INR 470 Crs.

demand_outlook.claim: Luxury housing demand across Mumbai has grown by more than 11%, led by upgradation by successful families and professionals.
demand_outlook.quote: Mumbai is a good example of this. Even as the overall housing market has moderated, luxury housing demand across the city has grown by more than 11%, led by successful families and professionals upgrading to bigger, better homes.

demand_outlook.claim: Supply in micro-markets like Worli, Bandra, and South Mumbai remains constrained with very little fresh land left.
demand_outlook.quote: At the same time, supply in micro-markets like Worli, Bandra, and South Mumbai remain constrained. There is very little fresh land left, so most new luxury supply comes through redevelopment, rather than greenfield construction.

capex_expansion.claim: Three new projects were added during the quarter: Lotus Impressa at Shivaji Park, Lotus Stellar in Versova, and Lotus Supremus in Juhu.
capex_expansion.quote: Three new projects added, Lotus Impressa at Shivaji Park in Dadar West, Lotus Stellar in Versova, and Lotus Supremus in Juhu, which adds INR2,700 to INR2,800 crores of GDV to existing GDV pipeline.

capex_expansion.claim: The company plans to launch four projects in the second half of the year: Lotus Aurelia, Lotus Sky Plaza, Lotus Portofino, and Lotus Odyssey.
capex_expansion.quote: Looking ahead, we are well-prepared for the second half. We plan to launch four projects, Lotus Aurelia, Lotus Sky Plaza, Lotus Portofino, and Lotus Odyssey, with a combined estimated GDV of INR3,500 to INR4,000 crores.

capex_expansion.claim: The GIFT City project sits on a 5.5-acre land parcel along the Sabarmati river and is expected to comprise 1.3 million to 1.5 million square feet of mixed-use space.
capex_expansion.quote: Sure. It's a 5.5-acre land parcel, which is sitting right on the river Sabarmati. It's in GIFT area. Recently GIFT authority has acquired in a way 300 acres, and this plot is part of that. This will be an ownership land only, and GIFT City would be planning authority in this. So, we are expecting that as soon as town planning scheme is declared, we'll get approval for mixed use. When I say mixed use, it would be commercial, retail, residential, all three components. And according to our calculation, approximately about 1.3 million square feet to 1.5 million square feet of space will be able to make there.

capex_expansion.claim: The company was appointed as preferred developer for three new projects adding INR 2,700-2,800 Crs of GDV.
capex_expansion.quote: We also made significant progress on business development during the quarter, where company was appointed as preferred developer for three new projects: Lotus Supremus (Juhu), Lotus Empressa (Shivaji Park, Dadar West), Lotus Stellar (Versova) and additional area secured for Lotus Insignia which together adds INR 2,700-2,800 Crs of GDV.

capex_expansion.claim: The GIFT City mixed-use project has an expected commencement in Q1 FY28 and completion timeline in FY31 with an estimated GDV of INR 2,000-2,200 Crs.
capex_expansion.quote:
Completion Timeline: FY31
❖ Expected Commencement: Q1 FY28
❖ Estimated GDV: INR 2,000-2,200 Crs

capex_expansion.claim: During the quarter, the company launched two new projects, Lotus Trident in Andheri and Lotus Aquaria in Prabhadevi, with a combined GDV of INR1,350 crores.
capex_expansion.quote: During the quarter, we launched two new projects, Lotus Trident in Andheri and Lotus Aquaria in Prabhadevi, together representing a combined GDV of INR1,350 crores.

capex_expansion.claim: The company was appointed developer for a commercial redevelopment project in Juhu with an estimated GDV of INR1,600 crores.
capex_expansion.quote: We were also recently appointed developer for a very, very prestigious commercial redevelopment project with an estimated GDV of INR1,600 crores in Juhu.

margins_costs.claim: Total revenue rose 53% year-on-year to INR269 crores in Q2, with EBITDA more than doubled to INR107 crores and margins expanding to 39.9%.
margins_costs.quote: In Q2, total revenue rose 53% year-on-year to INR269 crores. EBITDA more than doubled to INR107 crores, with margins expanding to 39.9%.

margins_costs.claim: For the first half, revenue stood at INR401 crores, EBITDA at INR155 crores, and PAT at INR134 crores at a PAT margin of 33.5%.
margins_costs.quote: For the first half, revenue stood at INR401 crores, up 69%, EBITDA at INR155 crores, up 95%, and PAT at INR134 crores, up 86% at an improved PAT margin of 33.5%.

margins_costs.claim: The company does not have any burden of interest as it is a net debt-free company.
margins_costs.quote: As far as margins are concerned, as I have mentioned earlier, we are a net debt-free company. So, we don't have to pay or we don't have any burden of interest.

margins_costs.claim: In Q2 FY27, EBITDA more than doubled to INR 107 Crs at a margin of 39.9%.
margins_costs.quote: In Q2, total revenue rose 53% YoY to INR 269 Crs, EBITDA more than doubled to INR 107 Crs at a margin of 39.9%, and PAT grew 91% to INR 89 Crs.

margins_costs.claim: Profit after tax grew 77% year-on-year to INR46 crores at a PAT margin of 34.5% for Q1 FY27.
margins_costs.quote: Profit after tax grew 77% year-on-year to INR46 crores, at a PAT margin of 34.5%.

margins_costs.claim: Q1 FY27 EBITDA stood at INR48 crores with an EBITDA margin of 36.4%.
margins_costs.quote: EBITDA stood at INR48 crores, growing 63% year-on-year with a healthy EBITDA margin of 36.4%.

orders_capacity.claim: Pre-sales for Q2 FY27 stood at INR470 crores, up 83% year-on-year.
orders_capacity.quote: Delighted to share that we recorded pre-sales for the quarter at INR470 crores, up 83% year-on-year.

orders_capacity.claim: The ongoing and upcoming pipeline comprises 24 projects with an aggregate GDV of approximately INR20,000 crores, of which 19 are redevelopment-led.
orders_capacity.quote: With these additions, our ongoing and upcoming pipeline now comprises 24 projects with an aggregate GDV of approximately INR20,000 crores, of which 19 are redevelopment-led.

orders_capacity.claim: For H1 FY27, pre-sales stood at INR 879 Crs, up 176% YoY.
orders_capacity.quote: For H1 FY27, pre-sales stood at INR 879 Crs, up 176% YoY and on track to achieve our full-year guidance.

capital_allocation.claim: As of September 30, 2026, the company had a net cash position of INR494 crores.
capital_allocation.quote: As of 30th September 2026, we had a net cash position of INR494 crores.

capital_allocation.claim: Estimated project-level surplus stands at approximately INR9,500 crores over the development cycle of the portfolio.
capital_allocation.quote: In addition, our estimated project-level surplus stands at approximately INR9,500 crores over the development cycle of our portfolio.

capital_allocation.claim: The company raised approximately INR792 crores through the fresh issue of its IPO with net proceeds of approximately INR732 crores, of which INR305 crores had been deployed as of September 30, 2026.
capital_allocation.quote: We raised approximately INR792 crores through the fresh issue of our IPO, with net proceeds of approximately INR732 crores after issue expenses, of which INR550 crores earmarked for our subsidiary for the Amalfi, Arcadian, and Varun. INR305 crores had been deployed as on 30th September 2026.

capital_allocation.claim: As of June 2026, the company held a total cash balance of approximately INR776 crores against debt of INR153 crores, resulting in a net cash position of INR623 crores.
capital_allocation.quote: As of June 2026, we had a total cash balance of approximately INR776 crores against debt of INR153 crores, resulting in a net cash position of INR623 crores.

capital_allocation.claim: Out of INR550 crores earmarked from IPO net proceeds for the subsidiary towards Amalfi, Arcadian, and Varun, INR271 crores has been deployed as of June 30, 2026.
capital_allocation.quote: Of the INR550 crores earmarked for our subsidiary towards Amalfi, Arcadian, and Varun, we have deployed INR271 crores as on 30th June 2026, and the utilization remains in line with our planned deployment schedule.

risks_headwinds.claim: The RBI raised the repo rate by 25 basis points to 5.5%, which is likely to weigh on affordable and mid-income housing.
risks_headwinds.quote: Earlier this month, RBI raised the repo rate by 25 basis points to 5.5%, its first increase since early 2023. While this is likely to weigh on affordable and mid-income housing, the luxury segment is far less sensitive to borrowing costs.

risks_headwinds.claim: Management noted that forward-looking statements are subject to known and unknown risks, uncertainties and assumptions that are difficult to predict.
risks_headwinds.quote: Such forward-looking statements are not guarantees of future performance and are subject to known and unknown risks, uncertainties and assumptions that are difficult to predict.

management_commitments.claim: The company plans to launch four projects in H2 FY27: Lotus Aurelia, Lotus Sky Plaza, Lotus Portofino, and Lotus Odyssey.
management_commitments.quote: We plan to launch four projects, Lotus Aurelia, Lotus Sky Plaza, Lotus Portofino, and Lotus Odyssey, with a combined estimated GDV of INR3,500 to INR4,000 crores.

management_commitments.claim: Management remains confident of delivering its FY27 guidance of pre-sales between INR1,800 crores and INR2,000 crores.
management_commitments.quote: Together with the momentum from our recent launches and a growing pipeline, we remain confident of delivering our FY27 guideline of pre-sales in the range of INR1,800 crores to INR2,000 crores, along with revenue and PAT growth of 55% to 60% over FY26 levels.

management_commitments.claim: Four launches are planned for the second half, comprising Lotus Sky Plaza, Lotus Portofino, Lotus Odyssey, and Lotus Aurelia.
management_commitments.quote: As we enter the second half, we are well prepared. Four launches are planned, Lotus Sky Plaza, Lotus Portofino, Lotus Odyssey, and Lotus Aurelia with a combined estimated GDV of ~INR 3,500-4,000 Crs.

management_commitments.claim: The company plans to launch four more projects over the remainder of FY27 with a combined estimated GDV of INR3,500 to 4,000 crores.
management_commitments.quote: Looking ahead, we plan to launch four more projects over the remainder of FY27: Lotus Aurelia, Lotus Sky Plaza, Lotus Portofino, and Lotus Odyssey, with a combined estimated GDV of INR3,500 to 4,000 crores.

management_commitments.claim: Management expects to complete the RCC work of Lotus Varun before January and complete 90% of the work by March.
management_commitments.quote: Now, we have around 20 slabs, so we are confident before January we'll complete the RCC work and 90% of the work will be completed till March.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
